authority_note: Interfaces define exchange capability only; authority per charter authority-matrix. No adapter holds approval or unrestricted publication authority.
exchange_model: channel-neutral masters in; target renditions, publication requests, receipts, and normalized observations out/in; credentials live in a dedicated connector secret store scoped to account+action; manual signed export always available

operations.detail: formats, aspect ratios, limits, quotas, account capabilities; independently versioned per adapter

operations.rule: platform rules live in the adapter; a platform-rule change may never require a narrative-domain migration (C2 gate)
only when the project's authority policy grants Storyworld publication; otherwise export-only

operations.effect: publication record with exact versions, external id, receipt, failure/retry
